name: register-milestone-closeout-process-fact
title: Register milestone-closeout.json in the process-fact registry and contract script
description: Pre-existing inventory omission noted by the B-12a1 round-2 docs reviewer: packages/main/src/core/store.ts writeMilestoneCloseout (writeJson at ~line 706) persists milestone-closeout.json, produced by the DONE-time capture path in packages/main/src/handlers/milestone-status.ts (~line 145, buildMilestoneCloseoutSnapshot -> store.writeMilestoneCloseout). The artifact is already listed in lifecycle-registry.ts (line 616) and scope-contract-smoke.ts (line 265), and the read-only milestone_closeout command is registered in process-fact-levels.ts (L0 readiness-read). But it is missing from BOTH the process-fact registry (packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts has no PROCESS_FACT_ARTIFACT_BY_COMMAND entry and no 'artifact:milestone-closeout.json' fact entry) AND the contract script's requiredArtifactFacts list (scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs line ~171). So the process-fact inventory under-reports a command-generated story metadata artifact, and the contract test cannot notice if closeout-snapshot handling drifts. Fix: register it in both places following the neighboring artifact:milestone-ledger.json pattern ({ name: 'artifact:milestone-closeout.json', path: 'milestone-closeout.json', signed: false }), with producer handlers/milestone-status and a consumer description matching its real semantics: the snapshot is frozen at DONE and later read by the DONE-phase milestone_status / milestone_closeout report path; it is snapshot-only and never re-blocks DONE. Unrelated to the scope-classifier registry work (B-12a1 and its follow-up).

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive: the story only mentions story_advance as the producerCommand metadata string to record in the process-fact inventory registry and the contract script required list. It does not modify story_advance, the story state machine, or any gate logic — the two touched files are a static inventory table (process-fact-registry.ts) and a verification script list (verify-process-fact-contract.mjs).
